const OPTIONS_TEXT: &str = r"Options:
  -b, --bin             binary mode
  -n, --number          output line number for each lines
  -f, --file-name       output file name for each lines
      --path-name       output path name for each lines

  -H, --help        display this help and exit
  -V, --version     display version information and exit
  -X <x-options>    x options. try -X help
";

#[repr(u8)]
#[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum CmdOp {
    Bin,
    Number,
    FileName,
    PathName,
    Help,
    Version,
    UcX,
}

impl CmdOp {
    pub const fn to(self) -> OptNum {
        self as OptNum
    }
}

impl std::convert::From<u8> for CmdOp {
    fn from(value: u8) -> Self {
        match value {
            0 => CmdOp::Bin,
            1 => CmdOp::Number,
            2 => CmdOp::FileName,
            3 => CmdOp::PathName,
            4 => CmdOp::Help,
            5 => CmdOp::Version,
            6 => CmdOp::UcX,
            _ => unreachable!(),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]

impl flood_tide::HelpVersion for CmdOptConf {
    fn is_help(&self) -> bool {
        self.flg_help

    fn is_version(&self) -> bool {
        self.flg_version
    }

fn value_to_type<T>(nv: &NameVal<'_>) -> Result<T, OptParseError>
where
    T: std::str::FromStr,
    <T as std::str::FromStr>::Err: std::fmt::Display,
{
    match nv.val {
        Some(x) => match x.parse::<T>() {
            Ok(d) => Ok(d),
            Err(err) => Err(OptParseError::invalid_option_argument(
                &nv.opt.lon_or_sho(),
                &err.to_string(),
            )),
        },
        None => Err(OptParseError::missing_option_argument(&nv.opt.lon_or_sho())),
    }
}
